prior_exposure: The reviewing agent previously inspected this retained filing, its full operating-fab table and the AI-critical baseline, and authored the earlier Fab 21 review. The agent coordinated with the implementation team and has now independently re-read and positionally parsed all sixteen data rows from the exact retained source bytes. This is an exposed collaborative source-evidence review, not a blind evaluation, independent publisher corroboration, or independent verification of physical operations.
rationale: Enumerate all sixteen data rows in source order from the single verified issuer operating-fab table, retaining its shared commercial-production commencement year header and blank spacer columns. Every selected row has seven direct cells with no merged-cell inheritance; source-native fab labels and commencement years occupy zero-based columns 0 and 2. The table describes the listed fabs as operating as of February 28, 2026. This creates a survivor-selected operating-facility cohort, not a census of all historical projects, starts, cancellations, delays, closures or failed construction. Accept only the issuer-reported year for each source-native facility label, with year precision and no midpoint. Carry forward the exact previously admitted Fab 21 observation without changing its admission clock or admitting it again. The other fifteen rows have unambiguous subject-year mappings under the same header and require no deferral at this limited source-report scope. No geography, canonical entity, project phase, ownership, technology at commencement, capacity, HVM alias, probability calibration or forecast score is inferred. The table's Fab 2 label is not NIST's Arizona Fab 2 project identity. All reported years are retrospective relative to the retained publication, retrieval and this actual review; none becomes an earlier system forecast or an independently observed physical event. The new source reports remain local reference-only evidence, not permission to redistribute the publisher body.
